name: 3rd Coast Developers
summary: Custom wrought iron gates, fences, railing and burglar bars for homes and commercial properties across the Greater Houston area.

hero.eyebrow: Iron gates, fences and railing in Houston
hero.title: Offering the highest quality
hero.lead: Hand forged, one-of-a-kind ironwork for residential and commercial projects, made from your choice of 100% American made steel, galvanized steel or aluminum. Tell us about the project and we will quote it.

groups.title: Fences
groups.summary: Long-lasting iron fencing for homes, yards and commercial property, in whatever material suits the job.
groups.intro: Commercial or residential, the shop forges fences built to last in the material that fits the project. Looking for something more ornamental and custom, that is where wrought iron earns its keep.
groups.imageAlt: A black metal fence running beside a lawn

services.title: Residential Fences
services.text: Fencing for the yard and around the pool, built to keep children away from the water and to look right in front of the house.

services.title: Commercial Fences
services.text: Extra security around a warehouse, yard or commercial building, forged in steel or aluminum and installed to suit the site.
points: Commercial projects quoted the same as residential

services.title: Custom Wrought Iron Fences
services.text: Wrought iron fence that makes a statement, hand forged to your design rather than pulled off a shelf.
points: 100% American made steel, galvanized steel or aluminum

groups.title: Gates
groups.summary: Driveway and access gates manufactured from American steel, aluminum or stainless steel to your own design.
groups.intro: 3rd Coast Developers is the leader in driveway and access gates in the Greater Houston area. Every gate is manufactured from 100% American steel, aluminum or stainless steel, with decorative or ornamental elements worked into your custom design.
groups.imageAlt: A black metal gate standing between trees

services.title: Driveway Gates
services.text: Custom driveway gates for the home or the office, from the straightforward to the extravagant.
points: 100% American steel, aluminum or stainless steel
Built for home and office entrances

services.title: Access Gates
services.text: Walk-through and access gates that control who gets onto the property without closing it in.

services.title: Custom Design and Finishes
services.text: Decorative and ornamental elements worked into your own design, with a large selection of colors to finish it in.
points: Speak with a trained consultant about the design

groups.title: Railing
groups.summary: Interior and exterior handrails, custom or classic, for staircases and walkways.
groups.intro: No staircase or walkway is complete without a charming handrail. Years of experience has taught us how much each detail of a house or building compliments each other, and custom or classic iron railing can transform a space.
groups.imageAlt: An ornate wrought iron railing with arched detail

services.title: Interior Handrails
services.text: Handrails for the staircase inside the house, matched to the detail already in the room.

services.title: Exterior Handrails
services.text: Rails for porch steps, walkways and entrances, forged to stand up to the weather outside.

services.title: Custom and Classic Iron Railing
services.text: Call for a free quote and one of our experts will show you what iron railing can do for the space, and a 3rd Coast Developer will treat you like family.

groups.title: Security
groups.summary: Wrought iron burglar bars for windows and doors, as simple or as ornate as you want them.
groups.intro: Recently broken into, or looking for more security? Wrought iron burglar bars add that sought-after peace of mind to a house or a commercial space. Window and door bars can be as simple or as ornate as you want them to be, and they can be made to compliment the building rather than hide it.

services.title: Window Burglar Bars
services.text: Bars fitted to the windows of a house or office so valuables stay protected, made as a custom piece rather than a stock grille.

services.title: Door Burglar Bars
services.text: Security bars and screens over entry doors, forged to match the rest of the ironwork on the building.

services.title: Quick Release Bars
services.text: Quick release bars that come away from the inside, to align with insurance concerns about barred windows.

promo.title: Ask about the first-time buyer discount.
promo.text: Installation is free and the work carries a warranty of up to ten years.

about.title: Hand forged metalwork for the Greater Houston area.
text: 3rd Coast Developers craft one-of-a-kind, hand forged works of art for both residential and commercial projects. Every piece is made from the customer's choice of 100% American made steel, galvanized steel or aluminum, and it is made to last.

From extravagant custom driveway gates to wrought iron fences that make a statement, the shop has the experience and the expertise to offer the highest level of quality, speed and customer service in the Greater Houston area. Call and a trained consultant will talk the project through, or come look at it on site.
about.imageAlt: A worker in a protective helmet grinding a steel beam, with sparks flying

values.title: Free installation
values.text: Installation is included on the fencing, gates, railing and security work the shop quotes.

values.title: 100% satisfaction
values.text: Customer satisfaction is the highest concern here, and every job carries a 100% satisfaction promise.

values.title: Up to 10-year warranty
values.text: The work is backed by a warranty of up to ten years. Ask for the terms when the project is quoted.
